title: Claims Coordination Note: Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance Death Benefit and Deferred Fixed Annuities Claim Interest
content:
Where Ashgrove has already paid a death benefit on the owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the death claim interest on the owner's Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract carries an earlier-claim coordination addition.

**Rule.** The earlier-claim coordination addition is **0.50% (0.005)** where Ashgrove paid a death benefit on the owner's Whole Life Insurance policy more than **30** days before this payment, **0.25% (0.0025)** where it paid one within 30 days before this payment, and nothing otherwise. The addition is made to the claim interest base rate.

**Records read.** The death benefit disbursement entry in the activity history of the owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, and its date; days are calendar days from that date to the date of this payment.

| Whole Life Insurance death benefit paid | Addition |
|---|---|
| More than 30 days before this payment | 0.50% |
| Within 30 days before this payment | 0.25% |
| Not paid, or no Whole Life Insurance policy | Nothing |

*Edges (hypothetical, this payment on 19 April):* whole life death benefit disbursed 20 March (30 days before) — 0.25%; disbursed 19 March (31 days before) — 0.50%.
